title: Role of Personal Data Protection Commission in Investigating Blood Donors' Data Leak
what_it_is: Role of Personal Data Protection Commission in Investigating Blood Donors' Data Leak

sections.label: PDPC enforcement against companies
sections.summary: PDPC will take enforcement actions such as directions and financial penalties against companies breaching the PDPA.

sentences.speaker: Mr S Iswaran
sentences.text: If found to be in breach of the Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA), PDPC will take the appropriate enforcement actions against the company, such as issuing directions and imposing financial penalties.

sections.label: Penalties for offences
sections.summary: The penalties include fines of up to $5,000 or up to two years' jail, or both.

sentences.speaker: Mr S Iswaran
sentences.text: The penalties include fines of up to $5,000 or a jail term of up to two years, or both.

sections.label: Public Sector Data Security Review Committee
sections.summary: The Prime Minister convened a Public Sector Data Security Review Committee to review data security practices across the Public Service.

sentences.speaker: Mr S Iswaran
sentences.text: Nevertheless, recent data-related incidents have underscored the urgency to strengthen data security policies and practices in the public sector.

sentences.speaker: Mr S Iswaran
sentences.text: Therefore, the Prime Minister has convened a Public Sector Data Security Review Committee to conduct a comprehensive review of data security practices across the entire Public Service.

sections.label: Committee report deadline
sections.summary: The Public Sector Data Security Review Committee will submit its findings and recommendations to the Prime Minister by 30 November 2019.

sentences.speaker: Mr S Iswaran
sentences.text: The Public Sector Data Security Review Committee will submit its findings and recommendations to the Prime Minister by 30 November 2019.

sections.label: Compromised server registration information
sections.summary: The compromised server held only registration-related information, including NRIC, gender, blood donation details, and in some cases blood type, height and weight.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
sentences.text: On Miss Cheng Li Hui's latter question, that information was not on the server that was compromised.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
sentences.text: Only registration related information was on that server.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
sentences.text: And if I can just cite for Miss Cheng this relevant portion from the vendor's statement, it says that the information that was on that server were National Registration Identity Card (NRIC), gender, number of blood donations, dates of the last three blood donations and, in some cases, blood type, height and weight.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
sentences.text: As for the first point, the unauthorised access is from various locations.

sections.label: Concurrent investigations
sections.summary: The investigations will proceed concurrently, informed by other inter-related activities.

sentences.speaker: Mr S Iswaran
sentences.text: But clearly, we would have to be informed by what is happening also in some of the other activities because they have some inter-related factors.

sentences.speaker: Mr S Iswaran
sentences.text: But the answer is, the investigations will proceed concurrently.

sections.label: Which Act covers data breaches
sections.summary: A Member asks whether the "Act" refers to the Public Sector (Governance) Act or PDPA, and the reply names the Public Sector (Governance) Act, Official Secrets Act, Income Tax Act and Infectious Diseases Act.

sentences.speaker: Mr S Iswaran
sentences.text: When the Member says that the "Act" does not refer to data breaches, only data misuse, is she referring to the Public Sector (Governance) Act or is she referring to PDPA?

sentences.speaker: Ms Irene Quay Siew Ching
sentences.text: I am referring to the Public Sector (Governance) Act, Official Secrets Act, Income Tax Act and Infectious Diseases Act.

sections.label: Ongoing investigations into data access
sections.summary: Whether data access occurred and whether any law was breached are matters covered by ongoing investigations, and information will be provided when ascertained.

sentences.speaker: Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai
sentences.text: How it is that there was access that was gained to the data and whether there was a breach of any law?

sentences.speaker: Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai
sentences.text: Those are all matters that are covered by the investigations that are currently ongoing, and, to the extent possible, when this has been ascertained, we will provide the information.
